title: Block Reset Calm (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Block reset calm block reset calm
Quiet hands soft like a balm
Block reset calm block reset calm
Slow the rally back to calm

[Verse 1]
Fast ball coming straight at you
Quiet hands quiet hands let it through
No swing no swing just a soft cushion
Let the paddle absorb without rushin
Vamos vamos manos suaves
Block reset cool the staves
Knees bent paddle relaxed and light
Take the pace off the flight

[Pre-Chorus]
Block reset calm
Soft hands like a balm
Block reset calm
The rally finds the calm

[Chorus]
Block reset calm let the pace die down
Block reset calm bring it to the kitchen town
Block reset calm absorb and drop
Block reset calm let the speed up stop
Vamos vamos pa lante
Block reset
Vamos vamos pa lante
Calm and steady ready set

[Verse 2]
When the speed up comes flying at the chest
Block reset is the safest test
No backswing no backswing zero
Let the hands turn into the hero
Uno dos tres soft and slow
Let the ball lose its glow
Drop it gently into the kitchen
The rally resets without friction

[Bridge]
Common error gripping too tight
Thats how the block pops up and out of sight
Light grip light grip relax the squeeze
Block reset calm in the breeze

[Chorus]
Block reset calm let the pace die down
Block reset calm bring it to the kitchen town
Block reset calm absorb and drop
Block reset calm let the speed up stop

[Outro]
Block reset calm block reset calm
Quiet hands soft like a balm
Block reset calm block reset calm
Slow the rally back to calm
